records.rationale: Resolved comma splice between two independent clauses into distinct sentences.

records.originalText: Please tell me when the next meeting will be held.
records.finalText: Please tell me when the next meeting will be held.

records.originalText: Please advise me of the date for the next meeting.
records.finalText: Please advise me of the date for the next meeting.

records.finalText: Let's put off the meeting until next Friday.

records.originalText: On the following day, we all had terrible hangovers.
